mapper.insert: INSERT INTO webform_issuance ( sales_user_id, customer_id, conversion_status_code, uuid_token, webform_status_code ) VALUES ( #{salesUserId}, #{customerId}, #{conversionStatusCode}, #{uuidToken}, '02' )
mapper.select: SELECT sales_user_id AS salesUserId, customer_id AS customerId, conversion_status_code AS conversionStatusCode FROM webform_issuance WHERE uuid_token = #{uuidToken}
mapper.update: UPDATE webform_issuance SET webform_status_code = '04', collected_at = NOW() WHERE uuid_token = #{uuidToken} AND webform_status_code != '04'
UPDATE potential_customer SET consult_status_code = '02', webform_received_at = CURDATE() WHERE id = #{customerId}
